findings.finding: The finalizer requires report candidate to be an ancestor of coordinator HEAD, but isolated task candidates are ahead of coordinator HEAD and finalization runs before fast-forward. Supported isolated writers cannot integrate.
findings.evidence: Two independent reviewers used genuine Red/Green fixture reports, retained Green on a task branch, reset the disposable coordinator to the recorded base/Red and proved HEAD is an ancestor of the candidate. _execution_row rejected with: traceability candidate is outside the active task ancestry.
findings.required_fix: Validate the report within the selected task candidate lineage, including supported pre-FF candidates, while retaining base/candidate/attempt bounds. Add a failing isolated-writer regression before correcting production behavior.

findings.finding: The finalizer requires exactly one execution although accepted plans and the adapter support multiple runners.
findings.evidence: Independent reviewer split the two accepted fixture cases across two unittest runners. Both real executions exited zero and both cases passed; public checkpoint_run rejected unsupported execution/case shape.
findings.required_fix: Validate all expected executions, their accepted runner configurations and their corresponding cases, then aggregate full task coverage and phase/outcomes. Add a genuine two-runner regression.

findings.finding: Verified run milestones remain only in memory until after fast-forward and the final transaction fold. There is no verification-complete checkpoint before fast-forward.
findings.evidence: Independent Spec review inspected the transaction. A separate bounded disposable probe replaced only the Git FF operation with a simulated interruption: the retained checkpoint still had task running, no recorded run milestones and no verification evidence, although three local run reports existed.
findings.required_fix: Persist the verified milestone under the existing coordinator lock before FF, with correct generation/cache replay semantics; persist the exact integrated state after FF. Add an actual pre-FF interruption/recovery test.

findings.finding: Pending report validation omits execution-to-accepted-runner and case-to-execution-phase bindings, so internally inconsistent evidence can become a durable Green milestone.
findings.evidence: Primary probe and independent Standards reviewer each changed a complete pending fixture report to use an unplanned execution runner/argv and case phase red while execution phase was final_green, then removed its ledger entry to model interrupted insertion. Public checkpoint_run repaired its ledger and published final_green. Normal completion rejects these bindings at completion.py:92,105,109. This does not demonstrate a bypass of the separate integration completion gate.
findings.required_fix: Apply the normal traceability execution, runner, case and phase binding validation before ledger repair or milestone publication. Add pending-report rejection regressions.

findings.evidence: Independent Spec reviewer inspected the mapped methods against accepted scenarios. Existing 8/8 passing reports cannot demonstrate assertions absent from those methods.
